data.description:
The captured YOURLS listing exposes 15 entries: an Oregon State University archived-news retrieval link, a JQP query selecting US stunting-series data from the Gates Foundation, twelve consecutive zzfill tests and one generic example-domain test. The two task-specific aliases are the strongest candidates. The page advertises 793 total URLs, but only 15 are visible in this capture. The host was already referenced in published evidence. The presence of an admin path does not establish unauthorized access.

Internal company attribution review (2026-09-28): OpenAI — low confidence. The same yourls.website host is explicitly used in published swarm record 44p5s for an SEC-data short link. The newly captured OSU-news and Gates Foundation/JQP links are compatible research-task artifacts on that venue. This gives a contextual connection to the OpenAI-linked activity, sufficient for an internal lead; no exact match ties these two aliases to a known agent, and the other 13 test entries are not independently attributed. This label is an internal attribution hypothesis, not a confirmed attribution or a publication-ready conclusion.
data.summary: A May 21 Common Crawl capture of yourls.website preserves 15 aliases, including two task-specific OSU-news and Gates Foundation data links. Two are strong research candidates; the other 13 are contextual tests, with AI authorship unverified.
